name: @conet.project/chat-sdk
description: Beamio CoNET Chat SDK — gossip messaging in a Web Worker (zero main-thread openpgp/verify) + encrypted fragmented IPFS history. UI-agnostic, reusable across SilentPassUI / bizSite / Alliance / POS.

scripts.test:conformance: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/genDaemonSchema.ts --check && node scripts/testDaemonConformance.ts
scripts.test:voice: tsx scripts/testVoiceReorder.ts && tsx scripts/testVoiceEntryPool.ts && tsx scripts/testVoicePeerWait.ts && tsx scripts/testInboundArmor.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:conformance && npm run test:voice

sideEffectsNote: Worker entry (./worker) is a side-effectful module; import only inside a Worker context.
